standard_prerequisites: The lisse-etale site of a scheme X: the category of schemes smooth over X with the usual etale coverings (Cohomology of Stacks, Section stacks-cohomology-section-lisse-etale)
A continuous functor u between the underlying categories induces an adjoint pair of functors u-s and u-small on sheaf categories (Sites, Section sites-section-continuous-functors)
Sites, Definition sites-definition-morphism-of-sites: u defines a morphism of sites exactly when the pushforward u-small is left exact
Sites, Lemma sites-lemma-pullback-representable-sheaf: the pushforward of a representable sheaf under base change is the representable sheaf of the fibre product
core_obligations: For a morphism of schemes f from X to Y the functor u from the lisse-etale site of Y to that of X sends V over Y to the fibre product V times over Y with X and is continuous, hence yields an adjoint pair with pushforward u-small from sheaves on X to sheaves on Y
Representable presheaves are sheaves on lisse-etale sites, and the pushforward of the representable sheaf of V is the representable sheaf of V times over Y with X

Take X equal to the spectrum of the field with p elements, Y equal to the spectrum of the integers, V-one and V-two both the affine line over the integers, with a the identity and b the translation by p; the equalizer of a and b as a sheaf on smooth schemes over Y is empty, since an equalizer datum would factor through the fibre of the affine line over the prime p, which is the spectrum of the field with p elements and is not smooth over the integers, so no smooth test object maps into it

After base change to X the two maps a and b both become the identity on the affine line over the field with p elements, so the equalizer sheaf on the lisse-etale site of X is the whole affine line, nonempty and smooth over X

If u-small were left exact it would carry the empty equalizer sheaf to the equalizer of the pushed sheaves, which is nonempty; contradiction, so u-small is not left exact and u does not define a morphism of sites; hence the lisse-etale site is not functorial
proof_roadmap: Set up the continuous pullback functor and its adjoint pushforward
Reduce the morphism-of-sites question to left exactness on representable sheaves
Run the characteristic-p translation example and compare the two equalizer sheaves
